education.qualification: Higher Certificate in Business in Accounting

experience.title: Accounts Assistant
bullets: Processed supplier invoices and matched them to purchase orders and delivery dockets for a yard turning over roughly forty thousand euro a week.
Maintianed the creditors ledger and prepared the fortnightly payment run for sign-off by the finance manager.
Completed the bi-monthly VAT return and recieved no queries from Revenue across five years of filings.
Reconciled three bank accounts and the credit card statement every Monday morning.

experience.title: Accounts Administrator
bullets: Raised customer invoices and chased overdue accounts by phone and letter, bringing debtor days down from sixty to thirty-eight.
Ran the weekly payroll for fourteen staff in Thesaurus and submitted the returns to Revenue.
Covered the trade counter at lunchtime and during staff holidays.

experience.title: Office Junior
bullets: Summer placement filing, answering the phone and entering supplier invoices into Sage.
Offered a part-time role for the following year on the strength of the placement.
